Downtown Phoenix.name: Downtown Phoenix
Downtown Phoenix.description: Washington/Central civic and sports core with office-to-residential conversions and the densest Planning & Development pipeline.

Midtown / Uptown.name: Midtown / Uptown
Midtown / Uptown.description: Central Avenue mid-rise corridor between McDowell and Indian School with mixed-use infill and renovation permits.

Encanto.name: Encanto
Encanto.description: Historic bungalow grid around Encanto Park with renovation-led permitting and neighborhood conservation overlays.

South Mountain Village.name: South Mountain Village
South Mountain Village.description: South-central grid along Broadway and Central with industrial-adjacent infill and steady structural/MEP permitting.

Ahwatukee Foothills.name: Ahwatukee Foothills
Ahwatukee Foothills.description: Master-planned south-Phoenix foothills community with solar OTC, residential additions, and constrained mountain-preserve edges.

Laveen.name: Laveen
Laveen.description: Southwest growth edge with new-construction tract permitting along Baseline and the Loop 202.

Maryvale.name: Maryvale
Maryvale.description: Post-war west-side grid with high permit volume in solar, fire-sprinkler, and small-lot renovation work.

Alhambra.name: Alhambra
Alhambra.description: Camelback west-of-Central corridor with commercial miscellaneous and residential alteration permits.

Estrella.name: Estrella
Estrella.description: Far-west village along the Estrella foothills with sparse new construction and industrial-edge permitting.

Sunnyslope.name: Sunnyslope
Sunnyslope.description: North-central hillside grid with renovation-led permitting and ShapePHX Issued density around Dunlap.

North Mountain.name: North Mountain
North Mountain.description: Preserve-adjacent north-central neighborhoods with residential additions and trailhead-constrained infill.

Moon Valley.name: Moon Valley
Moon Valley.description: North-central estate lots with the densest ShapePHX short-term rental operating-permit cluster.

Arcadia.name: Arcadia
Arcadia.description: Camelback-east citrus-lot estates with high-value renovation permits and strict lot-coverage overlays.

Paradise Valley Village.name: Paradise Valley Village
Paradise Valley Village.description: Tatum/Shea northeast village with mixed-use infill and professional-office permitting (not the Town of Paradise Valley).

Desert Ridge.name: Desert Ridge
Desert Ridge.description: Loop 101 / Tatum mixed-use node with hotel, retail, and multifamily permitting at the city's northeast edge.

Deer Valley.name: Deer Valley
Deer Valley.description: I-17 / Loop 101 employment and airport-adjacent village with industrial and residential permit velocity.

Norterra.name: Norterra
Norterra.description: North I-17 mixed-use town center with new-construction residential and commercial miscellaneous permits.

North Gateway.name: North Gateway
North Gateway.description: Far-north Carefree Highway growth edge with master-planned residential permitting at the city limit.
